The '''Phelarion system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the world of [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]].
